product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice SC100 Small Pencil Condenser Microphones with Interchangeable Omni Capsules - Pair
product.description: Although less common than their large diaphragm counterparts, some pencil, small condenser microphones excel by most performance standards, especially when used to capture high frequency detail. The Stage Right™ SC100 Small Pencil Condenser Microphones are no exception, delivering the professional studio quality performance of small condenser microphones costing several times their price. Small diaphragm condenser mics are the standard for recording any sound source that requires high frequency detail. From acoustic guitars to horns and even drums, the condensers in the Stage Right™ SC100 deliver better articulation, faster transient response, and exceptional high frequency shimmer, especially when compared to the more common large condenser mics. Additionally, the SC100s feature excellent transient response due to their small diaphragms, making them a perfect choice for drum overheads and other percussion instruments. Unlike ordinary pencil condenser mics, the Stage Right™ SC100 includes two pairs of interchangeable capsules, giving flexibility to an already outstanding microphone set. Simply unscrew the installed cardioid capsules and replace them with the included omnidirectional set, ensuring that you are always ready to capture perfect, natural acoustics, instantly. The Stage Right™ SC100 delivers performance and features rivaling that of professional studio mics at a fraction of the cost. Their wide frequency response and high maximum SPL ensure they perform at the level expected of real, professional recording microphones. The included replaceable capsules, mic clips, windscreens, and hard carry case complete a package that exceeds standards in both value and presentation.  1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well! Not to be outdone, our friendly and helpful customer service team is here to make your ordering, delivery, and any possible returns a quick and painless operation, from start to finish! Monoprice™, Stage Right™, the Stage Right logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
